records.local_title: The Patents Act, 1970 (Act No. 39 of 1970) - Provisions on Patentability and Traditional Knowledge
records.audit_notes: Official URL updated to current IP India Acts portal (superseding 2015 PDF link). Verified Section 3 exclusions verbatim: Section 3(a), 3(b), 3(c), 3(d) with explanation, 3(e) mere admixture, 3(h) agriculture, 3(i) therapeutic treatment, and 3(p) traditional knowledge exclusion. Verified Section 10(4)(ii)(D) mandatory biological source and geographical origin disclosure.

records.local_title: The Biological Diversity Act, 2002 (Act No. 18 of 2003) - Key Provisions on Intellectual Property and ABS
records.audit_notes: Official URL mapped to India Code legislative portal. records.official_title: Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940 & Drugs and Cosmetics Rules, 1945
records.local_title: Drugs and Cosmetics Act, 1940 & Rules 1945 - Provisions Relating to Ayurvedic, Siddha and Unani Drugs
records.audit_notes: Official URL updated to Ministry of Ayush quality standards publication. Verified Section 3(a) ASU definition and Section 33EEB patent/proprietary definition verbatim. Verified Rule 158-B licensing categories for Classical ASU (Category A - historical textual proof) versus Patent/Proprietary ASU (Category B - safety, acute toxicity, and clinical trial evidence). Verified Schedule I authoritative classical treatises.

records.official_title: WIPO Treaty on Intellectual Property, Genetic Resources and Associated Traditional Knowledge
records.local_title: WIPO Treaty on Intellectual Property, Genetic Resources and Associated Traditional Knowledge (2024)
records.audit_notes: Official URL mapped to WIPO GRATK Treaty index. Corrected critical legal status: classified as ADOPTED (24 May 2024) and NOT_IN_FORCE internationally (effective_from = null; entry into force requires 15 ratifications under Article 17). Corrected treaty structural fidelity: restored Article 5 (Sanctions and Remedies - opportunity to rectify before patent revocation), Article 6 (Non-Retroactivity), Article 7 (Information Systems), and Article 17 (Entry into Force).

records.local_title: Nagoya Protocol on Access to Genetic Resources and the Fair and Equitable Sharing of Benefits Arising from their Utilization
records.audit_notes: Official URL mapped to CBD Secretariat portal. Verified Articles 5, 6, 7, 12, 15, 16 verbatim against official treaty text. Confirmed legal status IN_FORCE internationally since 12 October 2014, distinct from Indian domestic statutory regime.

records.audit_notes: Classified as GOVERNMENT_PUBLICATION and authority_level = OFFICIAL_SECONDARY.
